_meta.indication: Treatment of inflammatory lesions of non-nodular moderate to severe acne vulgaris in patients 9 years of age and older

pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of sarecycline tablets (60, 100, 150 mg) vs placebo once daily for 12 weeks
pivotal_trials.population: Patients 9 to 45 years of age with moderate to severe acne vulgaris (IGA score ≥ 3, 20-50 inflammatory lesions, ≤ 100 non-inflammatory lesions)
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Co-primary: absolute change from baseline in inflammatory lesion counts at Week 12; and proportion of subjects with an IGA score of 0 (clear) or 1 (almost clear) with at least a 2-point decrease from baseline at Week 12
pivotal_trials.result: IGA success 21.9% sarecycline vs 10.5% placebo (p<0.001); mean absolute reduction in inflammatory lesion counts 15.3 vs 10.2 (p<0.001)

pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of sarecycline tablets (60, 100, 150 mg) vs placebo once daily for 12 weeks
pivotal_trials.population: Patients 9 to 45 years of age with moderate to severe acne vulgaris (IGA score ≥ 3, 20-50 inflammatory lesions, ≤ 100 non-inflammatory lesions)
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Co-primary: absolute change from baseline in inflammatory lesion counts at Week 12; and proportion of subjects with an IGA score of 0 (clear) or 1 (almost clear) with at least a 2-point decrease from baseline at Week 12
pivotal_trials.result: IGA success 22.6% sarecycline vs 15.3% placebo (p=0.004); mean absolute reduction in inflammatory lesion counts 15.5 vs 11.1 (p<0.001)

key_safety: The only adverse drug reaction reported in at least 1% of subjects was nausea (SEYSARA 3.1% vs placebo 2.0%); additional reactions in <1% of female subjects were vulvovaginal mycotic infection (0.8%) and vulvovaginal candidiasis (0.6%)
target_moa: Tetracycline-class narrow-spectrum antibiotic; tetracyclines inhibit protein synthesis by binding to the 30S subunit of the bacterial ribosome and have anti-inflammatory effects, though the mechanism of sarecycline in treating acne vulgaris is not known

rems.type: DRISK and the Division agree that a REMS is not needed to ensure the benefits of sarecycline outweigh its risks

advisory_committee.vote: An advisory committee meeting was not held for this product

basis.text: The application was a Standard review, not Priority

summary.text: NDA 209521 was submitted by Allergan under the 505(b)(1) pathway and received a Standard review; no accelerated approval, breakthrough, fast track, orphan, or priority-review designations were applied. No advisory committee was convened, no REMS was required, and no postmarketing requirements or commitments were recommended.

citations.quote: The regulatory action pathway for the application is a 505(b)(1).
No postmarketing requirements or commitments are recommended.
